ruleFamilies.name: WRITE_SKEW
ruleFamilies.property: a write path that decides on rows another writer can change (a reservation, a budget, a uniqueness) runs under SERIALIZABLE isolation or holds a lock covering its read set for the transaction, and a serialization-failure retry never reissues an external effect
ruleFamilies.appliesWhen: the deployable writes a store (any ownership but read-only)

ruleFamilies.name: FENCING
ruleFamilies.property: a lease-bearing deployable writes only with a monotonic fencing token that the store checks, or under a generation that the effect target checks; a holder that resumes after its lease expired is refused
ruleFamilies.appliesWhen: the deployable's catalog entry names a lease

ruleFamilies.name: CLOCKS
ruleFamilies.property: durations use a monotonic source; a wall-clock comparison carries a declared skew margin; a clock jump never extends a lease or a budget window; ordering uses sequence numbers or the fencing token, never wall-clock time; lease expiry is persisted, so a lease survives the replacement of its host
ruleFamilies.appliesWhen: the deployable holds a lease, or its clock use is not stated as NONE

ruleFamilies.name: OPERATION_IDS
ruleFamilies.property: an operation ID is minted once, carried unchanged on every effect edge and deduplicated at the effect's own store, so retries and outbox replays apply once (operationIds)
ruleFamilies.appliesWhen: the deployable's catalog entry names an outbox, or it is the tool broker on operationIds.propagation's path (its idempotency and receipt store)

ruleFamilies.name: COMPATIBILITY
ruleFamilies.property: every persisted record kind carries a schema version, and readers accept the previous and the current version in both directions during a rollout. Public input may reject unknown fields and versions. Stored envelopes keep opaque extension data without meaning or authority. Migrations name reader-writer pairs, including rollback
ruleFamilies.appliesWhen: the deployable persists a record kind (one entry per written store, cited by the store's purpose line)

ruleFamilies.name: DERIVED_DATA
ruleFamilies.property: every derived store (an index, an embedding, a projection, a cache, memory vectors) is fed from a change log or rebuilt from its source; a deletion reaches every derived store, with a receipt; a periodic rebuild-and-compare audit finds drift. Every data class names access, provenance, correction, retention, deletion and restore
ruleFamilies.appliesWhen: the deployable owns a derived store

ruleFamilies.name: REPLAY_STATE
ruleFamilies.property: the durable state a replay consults is an input beside the log, so a log-only replay vector is expected to diverge
ruleFamilies.appliesWhen: the deployable's catalog entry names an outbox or a replay (its replays read the log and the state beside it)

operationIds.origin: minted once, by the experience gateway or by the API caller
operationIds.shape: opaque, unique per business operation, carried unchanged
operationIds.propagation: through orchestration, the tool broker and the AI gateway to the effect, deduplicated at the effect's own store, so retries and outbox replays apply once; bound by tool effect class, never classified from an operation class's lifecyclePhase or idempotency

receiptKey.rule: the caller's receipt key is a function of the operation ID and the edge, never a fresh value per attempt

native.rule: the callee's idempotency is keyed by the same operation ID

none.rule: a handed-off effect carries the ID into its outbox record and is reconciled from a status lookup, never retried

toolEffectClasses.retry: retry freely; the ID is carried for tracing
retry with the same operation ID
no retry without a receipt key; an unknown outcome is reconciled
no retry; an unknown outcome is reconciled
